title: Eldritch Beast in Ruins
description: A muscular purple demonic creature with glowing purple accents and white crystalline growths on its head crouches in the center of a dark, decaying landscape. It is surrounded by tangled, broken geometric structures in shades of blue-grey, brown, and orange, with ethereal smoke rising from the scene.
